telemetry_aging_rules.recommendation: Segment by patch and gradually decay confidence as patch distance increases.

patch_era_segmentation.recommendation: Maintain separate telemetry cohorts per major patch.

stale_telemetry_invalidation.recommendation: Mark stale after major hauling, cargo, QT, UI, or freight elevator changes.

telemetry_archival_recommendations.recommendation: Archive but do not delete old telemetry; preserve for historical comparison.

calibration_retention_windows.recommendation: Use most recent compatible patch-era telemetry for active calibration.

confidence_degradation_over_time.recommendation: Reduce confidence when data ages, sample size is low, or mechanics changed.
